text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: —Huh? Um... why am I here again??

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Oh well☆ Let's hurry back home! Tonight 
we're having a Marvelous pillow fight, 
after all!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Mmm~?? There's no one here!
...I wonder if 
everyone went out to play...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She seems to have had a bad dream...
For a 
while, she wouldn't leave my side.
